checkedCadence: Weekly source check; urgent changes can be added through the Signal Intel Desk daily task.
method: Sourced, dated estimates only. No fake live counters. Red counters show figures or estimate markers only; titles and explanations render underneath. Where a reliable single estimate is not available, the counter uses an estimate-status value such as EST. SOURCE-SPLIT, MIN. REPORTED, EST. UNDERCOUNT, or STATUS-SPLIT. Crime, sexual assault, trafficking, migrant-status, nationality, ethnicity, suspect, charge, conviction, victim, and report categories must not be merged. This file was checked on 2026-07-20 against official or high-reliability lanes; unchanged live figures mean no stronger sourced replacement was found during the check.

panels.title: Gaza / Israel War
panels.status: Gaza Health Ministry reported death-toll lane; combatant/civilian split contested
panels.description: Checked 2026-07-20. No stronger official replacement total was found during this weekly check, so the Gaza Health Ministry reported death-toll lane remains above 73,000 since 2023-10-07. This is a reported ministry count, not an independently verified combatant/civilian classification. The ministry total does not separate combatants from civilians, and Israel-linked combatant claims must remain separate from reported total deaths. Keep Gaza deaths, Israeli deaths, hostages, injuries, child deaths, famine indicators, disputed official claims, and ceasefire-period casualties separate.
panels.sourceLabel: Gaza Health Ministry / OCHA OPT / OHCHR / UN Commission / Reuters / AP

panels.title: Ukraine War
panels.status: OHCHR verified civilian baseline; real toll likely higher
panels.description: Checked 2026-07-20. The verified cumulative baseline remains 16,402 civilian deaths and 48,428 injuries since 2022-02-24 pending a newer official cumulative table. OHCHR's 2026-07-14 monthly update verified at least 293 civilians killed and 1,990 injured in June 2026, the highest combined monthly civilian-casualty level since April 2022. In the first six months of 2026, OHCHR verified 1,396 killed and 7,978 injured, 37% above the same period in 2025. Keep verified civilian deaths, injuries, military casualties, missing persons, displacement, occupied-territory reporting limits, Russian-reported but UN-unverified figures, and infrastructure attacks separate.
panels.sourceLabel: OHCHR Human Rights Monitoring Mission in Ukraine / UNHCR / OCHA

panels.title: Sudan / Darfur
panels.status: Minimum reported death lane; wider death estimates, displacement, famine, and health collapse separate
panels.description: Checked 2026-07-20. No stronger nationwide confirmed death total replaced the minimum reported lane. Recent UNICEF/AP reporting cited at least 59,000 deaths, around 13 million displaced, and more than 30 million people needing aid. IPC's 2026 Sudan analysis remains the official food-security lane and covers the February-May 2026 situation with projections through January 2027, while warning that later projection coverage is geographically narrower. Keep verified killings, mass-casualty reports, higher disputed estimates, displacement, famine, hospital attacks, siege conditions, cholera, deportations, and humanitarian access collapse separate.
panels.sourceLabel: UNICEF / OHCHR / OCHA / IPC / IOM / WFP / WHO / AP / Reuters

panels.title: Global Displacement
panels.status: UNHCR Global Trends 2025 end-year official estimate
panels.description: Checked 2026-07-20. UNHCR Global Trends 2025, released 2026-06-11, estimated 117.8 million people forcibly displaced worldwide at the end of December 2025, down from 123.25 million at end-2024. The total includes refugees, internally displaced people, asylum seekers and other people needing international protection, with overlap adjustments applied by UNHCR. UNHCR separately reported 41.6 million refugees and about 68.65 million internally displaced people. Keep refugees, IDPs, asylum seekers, stateless people, returns, temporary protection, and newly displaced people separate.
panels.sourceLabel: UNHCR Global Trends 2025 / UNHCR figures at a glance

panels.title: Migration / Irregular Immigration
panels.status: Country and route data only; no honest global illegal-immigration counter
panels.description: Checked 2026-07-20. No reliable single global irregular-migration counter exists. Continue using route/country panels and preserve year labels: EU irregular border detections were just over 239,000 in 2024; EU first-time asylum applications were about 912,000 in 2024; U.S. unauthorized-population estimates remain survey/model based; UK small-boat detections passed 200,000 cumulatively since 2018 by May 2026; and Spain received more than 1 million regularisation applications by June 2026. Keep detections, persons, repeat crossings, asylum applications, regularisation applications, returns, removals, departures, estimated unauthorized populations, and missing migrants separate.
panels.sourceLabel: Frontex / Eurostat / CBP / UK Home Office / Pew / official national agencies

panels.title: Vaccines: Damages & Compensation
panels.status: Compensated, pending, denied and alleged-claim lanes separated
panels.description: Checked 2026-07-20. The U.S. VICP historical compensation baseline remains above $4.6B pending a cleaner current VICP cumulative total. HRSA's CICP data as of 2026-07-01 reported 14,146 COVID-19 claims filed: 6,562 pending or in review, 7,584 decisions, 112 found eligible, 62 compensated, 46 pending benefits determination, 4 with no eligible reported expenses, and 7,472 denied. Adverse-event reports, alleged claims, compensated claims, pending claims, rejected claims, causal findings, litigation claims, and scheme applications must remain separate.
panels.sourceLabel: HRSA VICP / HRSA CICP data 2026-07-01 / UK Covid Inquiry / UK VDPS
